lines: Screwdrivers: I am using the 54 bit set.

steps.title: Remove Exterior Screws
lines: Flip the device to show the back.
Unscrew the two screws on the top half of the device.
Lift off the panel using the small pull area at the very top. (Marked in yellow).

steps.title: Remove Battery
lines: Unscrew the 10 screws holding in the back panel.
Carefully lift up the panel from the bottom and unhook the ribbon.

steps.title: Remove frame and unhook things
lines: Gently lift off the coloured frames on the sides.
I recommend using tweezers to push back the spring so allow easy lift and placement.
2 big ones mid board, 1 center bottom edge, 2 Bottom right corner.

steps.title: Disconnect camera ribbon.
lines: Lift off motherboard and top colored piece.
Lift off screen carefully. It had adhesive so don't be surprised.

steps.title: Remove coloured bumpbers and shoulder buttons.
